workDates: 1881 — The Posthumous Memoirs of Brás Cubas (book edition)
verifiedScope.dateDistinctions: Markers use original Portuguese book-edition years rather than composition or later translation. English titles are shown for readability. The Hand and the Glove and Helena were serialized and issued as books in 1874 and 1876. The Posthumous Memoirs of Brás Cubas ran in Revista Brasileira from March 15 to December 15, 1880 before its 1881 volume. Quincas Borba ran in A Estação from June 15, 1886 to September 15, 1891 and appeared in volume in 1891. Poetry, drama, stories, criticism, journalism, translations, Machado's 1855 published poem and posthumous collections are outside the novel-book span.
verifiedScope.influence: No claim of influence is inferred from chronological overlap.
